prompt: A desktop web app screen for AYNI, an astronaut self-health monitoring app, rendered edge to edge at 1920x1080 with crisp readable text, no browser window, device or desk. The astronaut acts on an alert like an onboard spaceflight procedure, and the procedure leads the reading order. Top bar: AYNI wordmark, tabs Cuerpo 3D (active), Evolución y predicción, Medir y dispositivos, then Cmdte. Rosa, Día 140, Base marciana, chip Datos sintéticos, bell with 2, avatar. Directly under it, a single horizontal strip of zone status chips across the full width, each chip with icon, zone name and state word: Corazón Atención and Cerebro Atención first in amber, then Pulmones, Metabolismo, Riñones, Vascular, Músculos, Piel e inmunidad, Todo el cuerpo Normal in green and Huesos Sin dato in grey; at the strip's right end Aptitud del día with three small status pills Caminata espacial precaución, Precisión apto, Gravedad apto. Below, the left half holds the procedure for the selected zone as the primary panel: Corazón · Atención, Qué cambió: pulso en reposo 74 lpm, tu normal 62–68, desde el Día 137, steps 1–3 with checkboxes, a PRECAUCIÓN block for when to call the flight surgeon, Por qué pasa en el espacio, Fuente, buttons Ver evolución and Medir ahora; the right half is the holographic anatomical 3D body, large, heart amber, with a floating label. Footer: No es un diagnóstico médico. The reference screenshots carry the palette, the holographic 3D body and the dark space ground; their exact layout and panels must not be copied.
